sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Procedure for authorising expenditure before Appropriation Act takes effect
maudhui: (1) Parliament may enact a law providing for authorization of expenditure from the Consolidated Fund in accordance with the procedure set out in subarticle (2). (2) Where a financial year has commenced and the Appropriation Act relating to that year has not come into operation, the President may authorize withdrawal from the Consolidated Fund to meet necessary Government expenditure until four months have elapsed from the beginning of the financial year or until the Appropriation Act comes into operation, whichever occurs earlier.
